mapper.select: SELECT id AS sheet_id, request_hash FROM user_sheets WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND idempotency_key = #{key}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_sheets WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sheet_conversions WHERE active_user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instruments WHERE id = #{instrumentId} AND is_active
SELECT bpm_unit, default_bpm FROM jangdans WHERE id = #{jangdanId}
SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_sheets (user_id, title, kind, source, status, jangdan_id, bpm, bpm_unit, column_count, idempotency_key, request_hash, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, 'JEONGGANBO', #{source}, 'NEEDS_REVIEW', #{jangdanId}, #{bpm}, #{bpmUnit}, 1, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, #{acceptedAt}, #{acceptedAt})

INSERT INTO sheet_conversions (sheet_id, user_id, notation, instrument_id, jangdan_id, bpm, hwang_pitch, status, page_count, accepted_at) VALUES (#{sheetId}, #{userId}, #{notation}, #{instrumentId}, #{jangdanId}, #{bpm}, #{hwangPitch}, 'QUEUED', #{pageCount}, #{acceptedAt})
INSERT INTO sheet_source_files (sheet_id, file_idx, object_key, content_type, byte_size, file_name) VALUES (#{sheetId}, #{fileIdx}, #{objectKey}, #{contentType}, #{byteSize}, #{fileName})
mapper.select: SELECT c.sheet_id, c.notation, c.status, c.stage, c.page_count, c.processed_page_count, c.jangdan_id, c.bpm, c.failure_code, c.attempt, c.accepted_at, c.started_at, c.finished_at, s.note_count FROM sheet_conversions c JOIN user_sheets s ON s.id = c.sheet_id WHERE c.sheet_id = #{sheetId} AND s.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT s.id AS sheet_id, f.object_key FROM user_sheets s LEFT JOIN sheet_source_files f ON f.sheet_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{sheetId} AND s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.file_idx
